components.name: Delta-matroid decision infrastructure
components.summary: Oracle-driven delta-matroid algorithms, matching and matrix backends, declarative workflow execution, state-aware portfolio scheduling, SQLite run history, and controller-boundary runtime guards.
known_limitations: Cancellation and deadlines are checked cooperatively and cannot forcibly interrupt a blocked capability.
Serialized byte limits do not enforce CPU or memory quotas.
SQLite history is not a durable checkpoint/resume or exactly-once side-effect protocol.
Workflow approval flags are not authenticated identity or an authorization service.
StrongPath must retain the verified-lift condition; parity correction alone is not a universally valid lift.
Exact matching optimum verification uses bounded exhaustive subset enumeration and is intended for small instances.
No production deployment, security audit, or SLO is claimed.

validation.scope: GitHub Actions run 40130032418 at commit 9439c0ebcff2901a505adbdf0a6d0434b44c24ce: 59 module tests and 4 repository tests; package compile and wheel build passed.
